lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate nihakeval nirabaanee ||4||13||33||
lines.translation: O Nanak, attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they are detached, in the perfect balance of Nirvaanaa. ||4||13||33||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Gwaarayree, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur milai vadabhaag sa(n)jog ||
lines.translation: Through great good fortune and high destiny, one meets the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hiradai naam nit har ras bhog ||1||
lines.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is constantly within the heart, and one enjoys the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh praanee naam har dhiaai ||
lines.translation: O mortal, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam jeet laahaa naam paai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Be victorious in the game of life, and earn the profit of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan dhiaan gurasabad hai meethaa ||
lines.translation: Spiritual wisdom and meditation come to those unto whom the Word of the Guru's Shabad is sweet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਚਖਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur kirapaa te kinai viralai chakh deethaa ||2||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, a few have tasted, and seen it. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਕਾਂਡ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਚਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam kaa(n)d bahu karahi achaar ||
lines.translation: They may perform all sorts of religious rituals and good actions,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai dhrig dhrig aha(n)kaar ||3||
lines.translation: but without the Name, the egotistical ones are cursed and doomed. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dhan baadhio maaiaa phaas ||
lines.translation: They are bound and gagged, and hung by Maya's noose;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak chhootai gur paragaas ||4||14||34||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, they shall be released only by Guru's Grace. ||4||14||34||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 3 gauRee bairaagan ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl, Gauree Bairaagan:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਊਪਰਿਮੇਘੁਲਾ ਬਰਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਧੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaisee dharatee ooparimeghulaa barasat hai kiaa dharatee madhe paanee naahee ||
lines.translation: The clouds pour their rain down upon the earth, but isn't there water within the earth as well?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਮਧੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਗਾ ਵਰਸਤ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jaise dharatee madhe paanee paragaasiaa bin pagaa varasat phiraahee ||1||
lines.translation: Water is contained within the earth; without feet, the clouds run around and let down their rain. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਤੂੰ ਐਸੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa too(n) aise bharam chukaahee ||
lines.translation: O Baba, get rid of your doubts like this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਕੋਈ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਤੈਸੇ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karat hai soee koee hai re taise jaai samaahee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: As you act, so shall you become, and so you shall go and mingle. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸਤਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਕਿਆ ਓਇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: isataree purakh hoi kai kiaa oi karam kamaahee ||
lines.translation: As woman or man, what can anyone do?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ ਸਦਾ ਹਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanaa roop sadaa hahi tere tujh hee maahi samaahee ||2||
lines.translation: The many and various forms are always Yours, O Lord; they shall merge again into You. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਤਨੇ ਜਨਮ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ਸੇ ਜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਭੂਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: itane janam bhool pare se jaa paaiaa taa bhoole naahee ||
lines.translation: In countless incarnations, I went astray. Now that I have found You, I shall no longer wander.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kaa kaaraj soee par jaanai je gur kai sabad samaahee ||3||
lines.translation: It is His work; those who are absorbed in the Word of the Guru's Shabad come to know it well. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਹਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਹਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa sabad too(n)hai hahi aape bharam kahaahee ||
lines.translation: The Shabad is Yours; You are Yourself. Where is there any doubt?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਤਤ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫॥੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tat tat siu miliaa punarap janam na aahee ||4||1||15||35||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one whose essence is merged with the Lord's essence does not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again. ||4||1||15||35||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਲੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਬਾਧਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh jag kaalai vas hai baadhaa doojai bhaai ||
lines.translation: The whole world is under the power of Death, bound by the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: haumai karam kamaavade manamukh milai sajaai ||1||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do their deeds in ego; they receive their just rewards. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man gur charanee chit laai ||
lines.translation: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the Guru's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਲੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naam nidhaan lai daragah lae chhadaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, you shall be awarded the treasure of the Naam. In the Court of the Lord, you shall be saved. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਮਨਹਠਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh bharamade manahath aavai jaai ||
lines.translation: Through 8.4 million incarnations, people wander lost; in stubborn-mindedness, they come and go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਿਓ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad na cheenio phir phir jonee paai ||2||
lines.translation: They do not realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad; they are reincarnated over and over again. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh aap pachhaaniaa har naam vasiaa man aai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh understands his own self. The Lord's Name comes to dwell within the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: anadin bhagatee ratiaa har naame sukh samaai ||3||
lines.translation: Imbued with devotion to the Lord's Name, night and day, he merges in peace. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜੇ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: man sabad marai parateet hoi haumai taje vikaar ||
lines.translation: When one's mind dies in the Shabad, one radiates faith and confidence, shedding egotism and corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬॥੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak karamee paaeean har naamaa bhagat bha(n)daar ||4||2||16||36||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, through the karma of good actions, the treasure of devotional worship and the Name of the Lord are attained. ||4||2||16||36||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Bairaagan, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: peeeaRai din chaar hai har har likh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, has ordained that the soul is to stay in her parents' home for only a few short days.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sobhaava(n)tee naar hai guramukh gun gaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Glorious is that soul-bride, who as Gurmukh, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਮਲੈ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਵਾਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pevakaRai gun sa(n)malai saahurai vaas paaiaa ||
lines.translation: She who cultivates virtue in her parents' home, shall obtain a home at her in-laws.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sahaj samaaneeaa har har man bhaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs are intuitively absorbed into the Lord. The Lord is pleasing to their minds. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਸੁਰੈ ਪੇਈਐ ਪਿਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sasurai peeeai pir vasai kahu kit bidh paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Our Husband Lord dwells in this world, and in the world beyond. Tell me, how can He be found?

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap nira(n)jan alakh hai aape melaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Immaculate Lord Himself is unseen. He unites us with Himself. ||1||Pause||
